articles.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Surpasses Star Wars: The Force Awakens to Become North America's Highest-Grossing Movie of All Time
articles.summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day has overtaken Star Wars: The Force Awakens to become the highest-grossing movie of all time in North America. Domestic box office for the Tom Holland sequel is now up to $936.773 million, according to Variety.
body: Of course, The Force Awakens came out 11 years ago, so there’s inflation to consider here. But Sony and Marvel owner Disney won’t care; Spider-Man: Brand New Day has been an astonishing success, so much so that even movie executives were taken by surprise.
Earlier this month, Sony Pictures chief Tom Rothman said that Brand New Day’s popularity was down to the fact that it is, essentially, a movie about “a lonely guy.”

If you’re one of the few who hasn’t seen Brand New Day yet, it picks up years after the events of 2021’s No Way Home, and shows Peter Parker struggling to cope with the absence of his friends and loved ones following Doctor Strange’s memory wipe spell. A decent chunk of the first act of the movie is spent showing Parker’s inner turmoil and, yes, his extreme loneliness, which is fueled by the end of his relationship with Zendaya’s MJ.
points: Spider-Man: Brand New Day has overtaken Star Wars: The Force Awakens to become the highest-grossing movie of all time in North America.
Domestic box office for the Tom Holland sequel is now up to $936.773 million, according to Variety.
Of course, The Force Awakens came out 11 years ago, so there’s inflation to consider here.
But Sony and Marvel owner Disney won’t care; Spider-Man: Brand New Day has been an astonishing success, so much so that even movie executives were taken by surprise.

articles.title: Bloodborne May Not Be Getting A Sequel Or Remaster, But How About An Umbrella?
articles.summary: It never rains, but it does pour for Bloodborne fans holding out hope for some news on From Software's beloved game. Fortunately, you can take some shelter from that storm of disappointment with an official Bloodborne umbrella, and a few items for anyone wanting some souls-like couture in their…
body: Announced by the SuperGroupies fashion label, the Bloodborne collection includes an umbrella, necktie & tie clip set, card holder, laptop sleeve, and book cover. The "Childhood's Beginning" umbrella features illustrations of the Caryll Runes on the exterior and a silhouette of the Moon Presence floating in front of the red moon over a field of white flowers on the interior. Even though it's the most pointless piece of clothing ever designed, if you really need a necktie, you can get the Lady Maria-inspired tie and gaze at patterns inspired by the fan-favorite hunter. The matching tie clip is modeled after the lumenflower brooch from her cravat.

For the Bloodborne accessories, you can round out your look with a book cover that reflects the Vileblood Register, a card holder embossed with Caryll Runes, and a laptop sleeve that features a flap shape and studs that subtly reference the iconic Hunter Hat. Preorders start on September 15, and these items are expected to ship out in mid-April 2027.

articles.title: Save $10 on Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave for Nintendo Switch 2
articles.summary: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave comes out tomorrow for Nintendo Switch 2. That means today is your last chance to save $10 off physical copies of the game at Amazon and Walmart. In case you’re wondering if the game is any good, you can hop over to our 10/10 review to see what our critic thought of it.
body: Digital copies are $69.99 on the Nintendo eShop, and will be for the foreseeable future. But earlier this year, Nintendo started charging $10 more for physical games versus digital, presumably because physical cartridges and printing and shipping cost more than serving up downloads of data.

In response to this pricing change, both Amazon and Walmart have gone rogue among retailers and begun offering $10 off preorders of physical copies, bringing the pricing in line with digital copies. But once the game comes out, the price goes back up to MSRP – $79.99, in this case.

Generally, preordering can be a risky move because you don’t always know if a game is worth buying before reviews hit, or it comes out and gets a popular consensus. But right now, we’re in a beautiful window of time when reviews are live and the game is still discounted on Amazon and Walmart. But, again, today is the last day.

Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave is the latest in a long line of tactical RPGs that provide anime-inspired art and stories, turn-based strategy gameplay, and deep character interactions. People love these games, and for good reason — they’re usually terrific.

articles.title: Baby Born in Movie Theater During Harry Potter Now Has 'Cineworld' Listed as Place of Birth
articles.summary: A baby girl now has "Cineworld" listed as her official place of birth, after popping out during a recent Harry Potter screening. Elsie Lamb was born around 45 minutes into Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone (that's Sorcerer's Stone if you're in the U.S.).
body: BBC News reports that Potter-mad mom Molly Connah, 32, was overdue to give birth and had attended an appointment just hours earlier for a sweep — a process meant to encourage the start of labor. What happened next, then, could probably have been predicted — even if it still might have seemed like magic.
"I can remember the scene I was watching when I walked out," Connah said. "It was when Hagrid and Harry are buying his stuff to go to Hogwarts. I thought, 'something doesn't feel right'.
"It was getting more and more intense, and I didn't want anything to go wrong," she continued. "At that point I think my body just went into shock and it was pure adrenalin."
Thankfully, Connah was assisted by her mom, as well as staff at the Cineworld and nearby Starbucks, who provided towels and sheets.
points: A baby girl now has "Cineworld" listed as her official place of birth, after popping out during a recent Harry Potter screening.
Elsie Lamb was born around 45 minutes into Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone (that's Sorcerer's Stone if you're in the U.S.).

articles.title: Resident Evil Director On Who Should Play Lady Dimitrescu In A Resident Evil Village Movie
articles.summary: Director Zach Cregger's latest movie, Resident Evil, hits theaters this week, but if there were to be a movie based on Resident Evil Village, who should play the game's popular Lady Dimitrescu character? That's the question that Pedestrian TV put to Cregger recently.
body: Lady Dimitrescu, a tall vampire woman, was one of the most popular characters in Village. She was based on Morticia Addams and other wicked women. The developers at Capcom have spoken about her design, saying they wanted to avoid making her look too much like a Gothic vampire.

Hendricks is best known for playing Joan on AMC's Mad Men, for which she received multiple Primetime Emmy nominations. Hendricks is also known for playing Beth in NBC's Good Girls. She is an accomplished voice actor, too, having portrayed Gabby Gabby in Toy Story 4 and Cherie in Solar Opposites.
Hendricks has one video game credit to her name, and that's the role of Sam Harper in 2011's Need for Speed: The Run.
In Resident Evil Village, Lady Dimitrescu is portrayed by Maggie Robertson. She won the Best Performance award at The Game Awards for her performance.

articles.title: MindsEye Developers Say They've Been Laid Off Amid Questions Over Build a Rocket Boy's Future
articles.summary: Multiple developers of the disastrous MindsEye have said they’ve been laid off, casting doubt over the future of its controversial developer, Build A Rocket Boy. Story-driven action adventure game MindsEye was initially designed to be a part of Everywhere, the ‘Roblox for adults’ creation platform…
body: But MindsEye flopped hard when it came out in June 2025, with players calling it "broken," "buggy," and "the worst game of 2025." Soon after, BARB said it was “heartbroken” over the issues players had faced with the game, and promised to release a series of patches to fix the significant performance problems, glitches, and AI behavior bugs. Benzies told staff that the studio would bounce back and relaunch MindsEye, blaming its struggles on internal and external "saboteurs," among other things. CEO Mark Gerhard said the studio had been investigating what he called “criminal activity” that took place around the launch of the game.

In July last year, IGN reported that the Scottish studio had issued at-risk of redundancy emails to its then around 300-strong UK workforce. Subsequent rounds of layoffs followed, and this summer, fired staff protested outside the studio over an “all-expenses-paid playtest day.”
points: Multiple developers of the disastrous MindsEye have said they’ve been laid off, casting doubt over the future of its controversial developer, Build A Rocket Boy.

articles.title: Blizzard Boss On Why Diablo Is Becoming A TV Show And How Involved The Studio Will Be
articles.summary: At BlizzCon, Blizzard announced a partnership with Netflix for an animated Diablo TV show. The announcement caught some by surprise, but Blizzard president Johanna Faries said in an interview that it makes sense for the studio because many people simply don't have the time to invest meaningfully in…
body: “We have so much fandom around Blizzard that doesn’t always necessarily translate into hardcore gaming time,” she told The Los Angeles Times. “This is another way to deepen the relationship with our Diablo community and expand and broaden the conversation with our fans and potentially attract new fans, who may not have the time... to be able to devote hours to the gameplay, but certainly can devote hours to being engaged in this new form of storytelling."

Faries went on to say that Blizzard will be "very involved" with the Diablo show. This isn't always the case for transmedia adaptations, as Naughty Dog recently confirmed it will have no creative involvement in The Last of Us Season 3 on HBO. Additionally, Larian is not involved in the upcoming Baldur's Gate show.
Lydia Bottegoni, the executive vice president of story and franchise development at Blizzard, said bringing Diablo to Netflix part of an effort aimed at "meeting people where they are."
"The franchises themselves and the characters in the worlds have a lot of depth and a lot that we can share," Bottegoni said.

articles.title: Why Blizzard Stopped Protecting The Overwatch Formula To Save The Game
articles.summary: After a successful rebrand earlier this year, the mood around Overwatch has been far more positive recently. Speaking to GameSpot at BlizzCon, associate game director Alec Dawson attributed the recent success to ditching the fear of changing core systems--such as the introduction of a Perk system…
body: "Being able to continue to surprise people is really important," Dawson said. "We've heard a lot from players, like what they're looking for in the game, their return to narrative, and also, more heroes. But at the same time, we're going full-force to those things, but we also want to continue to say, 'Okay, where else can we push? Where else can we actually innovate?' We're just excited to continue to surprise people, and the community's been really receptive to everything we've been doing this year."

Keller added that Overwatch's first narrative arc spanning an entire year--focusing on Vendetta and Doomfist’s power struggle for Talon--has also been a big draw for players, as they can't wait to see how this storyline concludes. Combining massive mechanical shifts with heavy world-building story arcs appears to be a winning formula for the game, and Blizzard's gamble to drop five new heroes at once earlier this year also helped ease player toxicity in Overwatch. More changes are on the horizon, including a big rework for two legacy heroes, Roadhog and Sombra.

articles.title: 'Coraline' Studio’s Next Film Gets Breathtaking Final Trailer
articles.summary: Everything we’ve seen so far of animation studio Laika's next movie, Wildwood, has given plenty of reasons to be excited, and the film’s final trailer is no exception. In the latest preview, we see a witch of the woods kidnap a young girl’s brother, sending her on a quest to save her sibling.
body: Laika specializes in stop-motion animation. It is best known for the 2009 creepy-cute classic Coraline, but nearly all of its movies have been very well received. As for feature-length films, the studio followed up Coraline with ParaNorman (2012), The Boxtrolls (2014), Kubo and the Two Strings (2016), and Missing Link (2019). Wildwood is set for release on Oct. 23, 2026.

Travis Knight is directing the film, having previously helmed Kubo and the Two Strings. Chris Butler wrote the screenplay, which is based on Colin Meloy and Carson Ellis’ fantasy novel of the same name. Caleb Deschanel is the cinematographer, and Dario Marianelli handles the music.

The movie stars Peyton Elizabeth Lee ( Andi Mac k) as Prue McKeel, the teenager out to rescue her little brother Mac. Carey Mulligan plays Alexandra, the film’s antagonist. It also features performances from Jacob Tremblay ( Room, Luca ), Mahershala Ali, Awkwafina, Angela Bassett, and more.

articles.title: ‘Diablo 4’ Is Completely Free to Play On Steam for a Limited Time
articles.summary: It's a great time to slay demons: coming off BlizzCon, Diablo 4 is free to try on Steam until Sept. 21. The base version is also 75% off on Steam and the Blizzard Store, at $12.49. Loot grinding awaits.
body: Still, Diablo 4’s free-to-play week comes with a few major caveats. Apparently, this version of the game restricts players to a maximum level of 30. As one Steam review noted, “After 2.4 hours I reached lvl. 16 and then, after completing a quest, got boosted to 30 instantly and got kicked off the character.” Diablo 4 is also free to try on Battle.net, letting you play the expansion class Spiritborn up to level 25.

Since its release on Oct. 17, 2023, Diablo 4 has had a somewhat complicated reception. While critics praised the game for its sharp art direction and fun combat, many players were put off by its always-online requirements. The base game currently has 73% positive user reviews on Steam, but its most recent reviews have fallen to 62%, seemingly due to backlash over how Blizzard has handled its DLC. Many character abilities are locked behind the Lord of Hatred DLC, which costs a comparable price to the full game. While the game and both DLCs are bundled together at $69.99, there isn’t a discount for those who already bought the base game.

articles.title: Xbox's Fable reboot was allowed a 10-year development because the RPG series is "vital to the DNA of the platform", developer Playground Games says
articles.summary: Fable developer Playground Games has said "many people within Xbox view Fable as being vital to the DNA of the platform", which is why this game has been allowed such a long and "protected" development.
body: Ralph Fulton, director of the Fable reboot, revealed these details in an interview with The Guardian. "I genuinely think Fable is an important game," Fulton said. "What has protected us over a long development cycle is that so many people within Xbox view Fable as vital to the DNA of the platform. I would go a step further and say it's important to video games as a whole. It offers a combination of elements that simply doesn't exist anywhere else."

The Fable reboot was announced in 2020, though its existence had been talked about years earlier, and it marked a surprising change for Playground Games which had until then been known for racing games like Forza Horizon.

Actual development on Fable reportedly started in 2016, and the game has seemingly weathered multiple shake-ups, including the departure of the game's narrative lead in 2023. With Fable now set for release in 2027, it will be nearly seven years since it was officially announced.

articles.title: Knight of the Seven Kingdoms Season 2 Release Window Officially Confirmed by HBO
articles.summary: With the first season of A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms and the third season of House of the Dragon airing this year, Game of Thrones fans could potentially be left out in the cold in 2027.
body: Talking to Deadline following a successful night at the Emmys, HBO boss Casey Bloys shared updates on several of the company's shows. That included A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms. Bloys shared that the much-anticipated second season "is coming out in the first half of 2027." Since the show premiered in January 2026, that means the time between seasons will be a year and a half at most, which isn't actually that bad in the current prestige television landscape.

It is also faster than House of the Dragon, which has had two years between seasons so farz. Game of Thrones used to release a season a year (except for the two-year wait for the final season), so it's nice that A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms is getting back to that cadence. House of the Dragon is set to start shooting season 4 next spring, meaning it likely won't release until 2028.

The first season of the prequel series adapted the entirety of George R.R. Martin's 1998 novella The Hedge Knight. The second season will adapt The Sworn Sword, the second novella about the adventures of Ser Dunk the Tall and his squire Egg, who is revealed to be Westeros' king-to-be Aegon Targaryen V.

articles.title: Here's the second wave of Xbox Game Pass games coming in September
articles.summary: The second wave of games coming to Xbox Game Pass in September has been announced, and the list considerably improves what's already on offer, with a huge new arrival in Gears of War: E-Day, and notable arrivals in Dune Awakening, and Minecraft Dungeons 2.
body: Gears of War: E-Day needs little introduction because it's the big new Gears of War game - a prologue of sorts to the original Gears of War story, which follows Marcus Fenix and pals as they respond to the Locust invasion that later becomes known as Emergence Day, or E-Day for short. This is an important exclusive for Xbox, but will it be the banger it needs?

Dune Awakening's console debut has added interest because it brings a single-player mode to what was originally a multiplayer-first survival MMO on PC, when it launched there last summer. It's a game that's been shaking its massively multiplayer foundations since its release, in order to, presumably, appeal to more people, and with a third Dune movie arriving in December, it's a good time for it.

Minecraft Dungeons 2 we know less about. A sequel was something of a surprise when it was announced earlier in the year, and the question is how much it can build on the Diablo-like foundations of the original to fulfil the promise that Minecraft Dungeons 1 didn't - or at least not quite.

articles.title: Microsoft doesn't dismiss rumours a major Xbox Game Pass shake-up is on the way, which reportedly removes day-one game offerings entirely
articles.summary: Xbox could be planning another major shake-up of its Game Pass subscription service, this time removing key benefits the service is known for. That's according to a new leak from ResetEra user Slayven, who in 2025 revealed Microsoft's plans to raise Game Pass prices and change tier offerings, some…
body: Slayven's latest post said another rearranging of Game Pass tiers, and their names, is in the works. The service is reportedly going to drop slightly in price with the caveat of removing day-one games - new games offered on Game Pass the day they launch.
An ad-supported tier is also said to be coming, and cloud streaming is apparently being removed from Game Pass entirely. The change is reportedly due to take place between February and April 2027.
Microsoft hasn't directly addressed the specifics of the rumour but told Forbes reporter Paul Tassi that no changes are currently planned.

"We regularly test different Game Pass offerings and look at what works best for players in different markets. We don't have any changes to announce today or plans that have been finalised. There are no changes to previously announced games coming to Game Pass Ultimate on day one," Microsoft's statement read.

videos.title: Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen - Official Main Trailer | Capcom Spotlight TGS 2026
videos.summary: Check out the Main Trailer for Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen, an upcoming expansion to the hit open-world action RPG developed by Capcom. Players will embark on a new adventure with tales to experience and action-packed encounters to overcome.
points: Check out the Main Trailer for Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen, an upcoming expansion to the hit open-world action RPG developed by Capcom.
Players will embark on a new adventure with tales to experience and action-packed encounters to overcome.
Explore a new area in the Snowy North to take on 12 Dungeon Challenges and unlock new weapons and skills along the way.
Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen is launching on October 9 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
videos.author: IGN
